scenario: The ego vehicle approaches and closes in on a slower lead vehicle traveling straight on a multi-lane urban road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward at a higher speed and gradually reduces its distance to the lead vehicle ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward at a lower constant speed in the same lane ahead of the ego vehicle.

requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a defined initial distance behind the lead vehicle, and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has closed to a specified following distance or has traveled a set distance.
